Name: Balanced Valley - Mining
Author: o0MrPro
Description:
[center]
[color=#ff0000][size=6]MOVED TO [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13970?tab=description]Balanced Valley[/url]﻿
FOR BETTER FEATURES AND UPDATES
THIS WILL NO LONGER BE SUPPORTED[/size][/color]

I love going to the mines and skull cavern and always come back with a full inventory but low value after a long day in there
 this mod changes the prices of artifacts, minerals, and gems to make it worth the time and sweat invested in the mines for adrenalin lovers.
we all know that minerals and artifacts become trash after redeeming them once in the museum, this mod is meant to fix that and give them their real value!
[b].
[/b][b][size=4].
[/size].[/b]
[b][size=3]Features[/size][/b]
[b]▼[/b]
[size=3][b]↬ Balanced Mode ↫[/b]
[size=3]- Changing the geodes system into classes and you get specific minerals from each geode type.
- Balances minerals and artifacts, minerals and artifacts are NOT trash anymore.[/size]
[size=3]- Makes completing the museum more balanced.
- Treasure chests in fishing are more rewarding now.
- Increasing monster loot prices
- Balancing ore bar prices[/size]
[/size][size=3]- this mode is balanced to be used with my other mods for a balanced playthrough
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12900]Balanced Valley - Realistic Farming[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13016]Balanced Valley - Fishing﻿
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13172][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12809]Balanced Valley - Animals[/url]
[/size][color=#b6b6b6][size=2]however, you still can use it without them

[/size][/color][size=3][b]↬ Normal Mode ↫[/b]
- same features as balanced mode.
[/size][size=3]- 50% more profit than balanced mode (balanced and more profitable than vanilla)[/size]
[size=3]- you can use it as a standalone version or even with my other mods if you want more mining profit[/size]

[b][size=3]↬ Spreadsheet data ↫[/size]
[/b][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TPYyNSwtZovOy8-Am27jMr2UFWZ1-EV68m9_RayeyUk/edit?usp=sharing](you can check and compare all changes here)[/url]﻿[b]﻿﻿﻿[/b]

[size=3][b]Config[/b]
▼[/size][size=3]
[b]Balance Mode[/b] [/size][size=3][Balanced Mode, Normal Mode] default is[/size][size=3][b] Balanced Mode[/b]
this will change the balance mode

[b]Better Monster Loot[/b] [true, false] default is[b] true[/b]
this will enable/disable increasing monster loot feature

[/size][/center][center][size=3][b]Requirements & Install[/b][/size][/center][center]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI
[/url]- ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]
[/url]﻿﻿﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (optional if you want to edit the mode in-game)[/center][center]
unzip and put the folder into your mods folder
[size=2]ALWAYS DELETE THE LAST VERSION BEFORE INSTALLING A NEW VERSION.[/size][/center][center]
[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b]
[/size]Compatible with any mod that doesn't change the same things this mod does.
Compatible with mobile and multiplayer (everyone has to install the mod)[/center][center][b].
[size=4].
[/size].[/b]
all in all, I hope you guys like this mod, if you have any bugs or ideas to improve this mod I'm all ears for you, take care :D[/center]
